title: Effects of Fresh Mango Pulp Consumption on Satiety and Cardiometabolic Health
official: Effects of Fresh Mango Pulp Consumption on Satiety and Cardiometabolic Health
summary: The objective of the study is to determine the effects of fresh mango pulp consumption on satiety and metabolic parameters in overweight/obese adults.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18-55 years old
* BMI 27-40

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smoker
* Pregnant woman
* Required dietary supplement use
* Required medication of metabolic disorders
* Allergy to mango or gluten

sites.f: School of Exercise and Nutritional Sciences, SDSU
